summary: Phase 149O.19.5D -- HMIC Active Certification Validation Engine: bounded production implementation, Wave D of 5 under HMIC-001 v1.0 (docs/PHASE_149O_19_4_HATP_MANDATORY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_CERTIFICATION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md Sec9.3). Confirmed baseline via direct inspection: repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.19.5C completed/complete, hardcoded False ceiling unchanged, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read the HMIC-001 v1.0 contract directly (validation algorithm Sec31, status vocabulary/readiness mapping Sec32, validation API/freshness Sec33, activation-readiness integration Sec34, certification/activation independence Sec35) and the 149O.19.4 plan's Wave-D API surface (Sec9.3) via direct source inspection. Extended src/pcae/core/hatp_mandatory_certification.py (sole production file touched) with: HMICValidationResult (frozen typed result, status/reason only, no readiness/activation field), the internal test-only seam _validate_at_root(*, protected_root, repository_root), and the production entrypoint validate_active_hatp_mandatory_independent_verification_certification(repository_root). Implements HMIC-REQ-103's exact 12-step algorithm in order over Wave A/B/C's existing types/derivations/readers (no second parser, identity scheme, or protected-root resolution): resolve repository/deployment identity fresh (ACCESS_ERROR on derivation failure, a documented interpretation extending HMIC-REQ-105 by analogy since no contract status is explicitly named for this step), load the active binding (MISSING if absent/unbound), load the named certification record (MISSING if not found, MALFORMED if the document is malformed), check repository/deployment match (WRONG_REPOSITORY/WRONG_DEPLOYMENT), check status==active (REVOKED), recompute implementation identity fresh and compare both terms (IMPLEMENTATION_MISMATCH), recompute contract versions fresh and compare (CONTRACT_MISMATCH), re-derive certification_id for self-consistency (MALFORMED), and only then VALID. Deliberately diverged from the 149O.19.4 plan's own illustrative (non-binding) _validate_at_root(protected_root, repository_instance_id, canonical_deployment_root) shorthand signature: this phase's own governing prompt and HMIC-REQ-045/110 explicitly forbid caller-suppliable repository_instance_id/canonical_deployment_root on any path, including the test seam, so this phase instead derives both freshly inside the function from a repository_root parameter -- documented explicitly in the phase doc Sec8. No cache of any kind; every call re-runs all 12 steps. Never acquires .certification-transition.lock and never calls a Wave-C write primitive (AST-verified). Zero production callers at phase exit -- hatp_mandatory_cutover.py remains byte-unchanged and never imports this module; the hardcoded False ceiling is untouched; Stop Condition W-1 remains mandatory, now concrete since the validator exists (its own two new functions are the exact future v1.1-amendment subjects). Added a 51-test Wave-D suite (tests/test_phase_149o_19_5d_hmic_active_certification_validation_engine.py) covering: VALID control-flow proof (immutability, no forbidden fields); all 9 status outcomes individually reached; 3 multi-defect status-precedence combinations; 6 freshness/no-cache tests plus a static no-lru_cache source check; 1 real-thread concurrent-revocation confirmatory test; inspect.signature-based no-caller-suppliable-authority-input checks for both the production entrypoint and the internal seam, plus a no-root-override-via-environment-variable test against the real production entrypoint; AST-based no-write-primitive-call and no-forbidden-import structural checks; a repository-wide zero-production-caller grep; an exhaustive readiness-mapping re-confirmation over all 9 CertificationStatus members. All fixtures use an isolated, git-initialized tmp_path repository with monkeypatch-substituted frozen-file-set/contract-identity constants (the identical seam pattern the 149O.19.5B suite's own fixture_repo established) -- never this repository's own real frozen files mutated to induce a mismatch. Widened one 149O.19.5C-era stale scope-boundary assertion in place (deliberate, mirrors the existing widening precedent already in this repository's history): test_no_validation_function_exists_in_module now allowlists the two new Wave-D symbols by name, since Wave C's own assertion (no Wave-D-shaped symbol exists yet) is legitimately superseded once Wave D, a later separately-authorized phase, adds them -- the test's actual purpose (Wave C's storage layer never itself judges validity) is unchanged and still enforced by every other assertion in that suite. Fast Green: true git stash -u A/B baseline (not just an uncommitted-diff comparison) -- baseline 33 failed/5975 passed, post-implementation 35 failed/6024 passed; exact diff of the sorted FAILED line lists confirms all 33 baseline failures byte-identical between runs (unrelated pre-existing issues), and exactly 2 net-new failures, both the same already-documented benign class this repository's own phase docs record repeatedly: an older phase's own 'no src/pcae change since my fixed historical entry commit' assertion, tripped for the first time by this file's first touch since that old baseline -- not a functional regression. Clean deselected run (all 35 pre-existing/newly-tripped nodeids explicitly deselected): 0 failed, 6024 passed, 1 skipped, 25674 deselected. No real certification state created; no real activation occurred. B-149O.19.3-1 remains independently closed, unchanged. B-149O-1..4 verdict unchanged, carried forward: INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CLOSED AT SYSTEM IMPLEMENTATION/ENFORCEMENT BOUNDARY -- DEPLOYMENT/OPERATIONAL ACTIVATION DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Verdict: HMIC ACTIVE CERTIFICATION VALIDATION ENGINE: IMPLEMENTED -- READY FOR NEXT BOUNDED HMIC IMPLEMENTATION WAVE.
